thread:
Alex S: Heads-up — Nimbus Bank (Priya K) asked for ISO27001 scoping + a simple data-flow for their vendor risk POC. They want explicit applicability language and confirmation on KMS custody.
Tara L: Quick: do they need inference-only scope, or also logs/analytics?
Alex S: Priya said they need both: clear statement on what our ISMS covers and what it excludes, plus retention timelines. Also asked if Dedicated = in-scope and if Private with BYOK changes anything.
Mike I: Short answer: production inference runtime & control plane are in-scope. Non-prod, training pipelines, and partner sandboxes are out-of-scope. For key custody: Private supports customer-managed KMS (BYOK) — that lets customers retain key custody; Hosted uses Redwood-managed keys by default; Dedicated can be BYOK via contract.
Tara L: Can we give them two short sentences they can drop into the questionnaire?
Mike I: Draft wording: "Redwood Inference's ISMS covers the production inference runtime, the associated control plane, and operational processes that support customer workloads. Development, training, and partner sandbox environments are excluded from this ISMS; customers using Private deployments with customer-managed KMS maintain custody of their encryption keys."
Alex S: Perfect. Priya also wants a tiny ascii data flow she can paste into the vendor form. I sketched this:
[Customer App] -> [Ingress LB (region)] -> [Inference Runtime (GPU) {KV cache, ephemeral tensors}] -> [Control Plane / Logs] -> [Metrics & Analytics (redacted/encrypted)]
KMS: Inference Runtime -> KMS (encrypt caches at rest); Control Plane -> KMS (secrets); Logs -> service-encrypted -> KMS-managed keys
Tara L: Security — confirm retention numbers we should share. Also they asked about cache TTL and deletion on offboarding.
Mike I: Retention bullets to share: - Operational logs: 90 days (raw) - Aggregated metrics: 24 months - KV cache (prefixes): ephemeral, default TTL 24h (configurable per-customer) - Offboarding data wipe: scheduled within 30 days from termination request
Mike I: Also note: multitenancy isolation: runtime uses tenant namespaces + process isolation on Dedicated; network isolation for Private (VPC, no shared routing).
Julia C: I'll assemble the evidence pack: applicability statement (using Mike's wording), ascii data flow, screenshot of KMS integration UI for Private, and a snippet of retention policy. I can send to Priya by EOW if we agree.
Alex S: Please cc Priya. If they require contractual BYOK guarantees or audit evidence that BYOK keys are never in Redwood control, we should loop in Legal and Sales Ops.
Tara L: I'll grab the config screenshots from staging Private (sanitized).
OpsBot: attaching: iso-checklist.pdf (auto-upload)
Mike I: One more: include the excerpt that training pipelines are explicitly excluded: "Model training and dataset preprocessing environments are out of scope of Redwood's ISMS and are not used to serve customer inference workloads."
Alex S: Great. Action items: Julia -> draft & send to Priya by Friday; Mike -> paste final wording + retention numbers into doc; Tara -> screenshots; Alex -> loop Legal if Priya pushes for contract language.
Julia C: got it, assigning now.
Tara L: :thumbsup:
Alex S: thanks team, I'll update the deal doc with the scoping note and attach Julia's pack when ready.
Mike I: If Priya asks for evidence files (audit reports), note that ISO cert is for our ISMS boundary; Dedicated/Private nuances are covered in the applicability statement and contractual terms.
Alex S: noted.
notes: contains PII-lite references to customer contact (Priya K) but participants are Redwood employees only
